description: This source file provides utility functions for flushing, syncing, and writing data to files or stdout, with error handling. It includes functions like maybe_flush_or_die, fprintf_or_die, fsync_or_die, write_or_die, fwrite_or_die, and fflush_or_die, used for robust file operations in a larger software project.

methods.name: void maybe_flush_or_die(FILE * f,const char * desc)
methods.description: Flushes the given FILE stream, with error handling and environment-controlled behavior, especially for stdout.

methods.name: void fprintf_or_die(FILE * f,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a FILE stream, with error handling.

methods.name: void fsync_or_die(int fd,const char * msg)
methods.description: Synchronizes a file descriptor's data to disk, with error handling.

methods.name: int fsync_component(enum fsync_component component,int fd)
methods.description: Performs fsync on a specified component if configured.

methods.name: void fsync_component_or_die(enum fsync_component component,int fd,const char * msg)
methods.description: Performs fsync on a specified component, aborting on error.

methods.name: void write_or_die(int fd,const void * buf,size_t count)
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor, with error handling.

methods.name: void fwrite_or_die(FILE * f,const void * buf,size_t count)
methods.description: Writes data to a FILE stream, with error handling.

methods.name: void fflush_or_die(FILE * f)
methods.description: Flushes a FILE stream, with error handling.

ctags.pattern: /^void fsync_component_or_die(enum fsync_component component, int fd, const char *msg)$/

ctags.pattern: /^void write_or_die(int fd, const void *buf, size_t count)$/
